## Summary

## Change type

- [ ] Feature

## Boundaries affected

- [ ] Public API or OpenAPI contract

- [ ] Generated artifacts or release behavior

## Validation

<!-- List commands actually run and relevant manual verification. GitHub checks show CI and CodeRabbit status. -->

```text

```

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the changed behavior.
- [ ] OpenAPI was regenerated and reviewed when the API changed.
- [ ] Documentation was updated where behavior or setup changed.
- [ ] No secrets, generated build output, or personal editor files are included.
